facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Singular: was built. Plural: were made. Pergunta: When was it opened? Quem fez: by + pessoa. Data com in: in 1890.

facts.label: Foi construído
facts.sub: Use was built para dizer quando algo foi construído. The museum was built in 1890. Para vários objetos, use were: The doors were made of wood. O particípio de build é built.

facts.label: Foi aberto
facts.sub: Use was opened para lugares e eventos. The café was opened in 2015. O particípio opened é igual ao passado simples, mas depois de was/were ele forma o passivo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The museum was built in 1890” is a past passive.
We say “The doors was made of wood”.
We can add by to say who did it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The museum was built in 1890” is a past passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The doors was made of wood”. → Falso (Plural: were made.)
We can add by to say who did it. → Verdadeiro (Yes: designed by a builder.)

pages.title: A day at an old museum · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold, grey morning in Edinburgh. Dale and Tom stand in front of an old museum. The stone walls look very strong. Dale loves history, so he reads every sign. Tom wants to know when everything was built. They buy two tickets and go inside.

“Tom, this museum was built in 1890. Can you believe it?” says Dale. “Wow, it is old. When was it opened to the public?” says Tom. “It was opened a few years later, I read. The big hall was added in 1920.” says Dale.
